thread:
Alex: Proportional question for lunch: if our Slack messages were an LLM, which model would be the office sock puppet? Vote with emoji.
Maya: hahah love this. define: sock puppet = the one that says exactly what you want to hear at 3pm.
Zoe: options please.
Tom: 1) "Flattery-7B" (very agreeable) 2) "Contrarian-1.2" (always jokes) 3) "Helpdesk-13B" (polite, vague) 4) "DadJoke-XL" (puns).
persona-bot: quick note: this is a purely hypothetical model persona poll. reactions will be tallied in-thread.
Alex: vote by replying with the number or drop an emoji.
Maya: 4 :laughing: - DadJoke-XL all day.
Zoe: 2 :rolling_eyes: - ready to argue about coffee order.
Tom: 1 :heart: - I need the flattery late-afternoon.
Alex: tally so far 1(1),2(1),4(1),3(0). close race.
Zoe: follow-up: what would the puppet's signature line be? short please.
Maya: DadJoke-XL: "I'm reading a book on anti-gravity. It's impossible to put down."
Tom: Flattery-7B: "That PR? Absolute poetry. Ship it."
Zoe: Contrarian-1.2: "You should probably do the opposite, but also maybe not."
Alex: Helpdesk-13B: "Have you tried turning your lunch into a stand-up? Please provide repro steps."
persona-bot: bonus one-liners generated: ["Auto-suggest: more snacks"] (posted for morale).
Maya: winner by consensus: DadJoke-XL. we shall adopt the sock puppet persona for next Friday's #random thread.
Tom: make it wear tiny emoji glasses. also assign the puppet an email alias.
Alex: done. persona-bot will post a welcome message Fri 12:00 PT. thread closed, carry on with your delightful nonsense.
